label: BIGO Ads
terms_note: Help center read; Marketing API access is by account-manager application only

discovery.auth: token (developerId + token issued by BIGO; marketing API permission via the account manager)

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **partial** (Web Events / S2S conversion API for advertisers; publisher Reporting API; campaign API by manager approval) Confidence: **medium**.
auth: 1. BIGO Ads advertiser account (bigoads.com → Get Started).
2. Pixel / Web Events API credentials from the ad account (Tracking Integration → Web S2S).
3. For campaign management via API, apply for the marketing API permission through the Bigo Ads manager.

endpoints.notes: pixel id, event name, event time, user data hashed, value

reference.limits: - Free; BIGO Ads terms; marketing API by approval.

reason: Re-checked 2026-09-25 in headless Chromium: the only advertiser API page on the BIGO Ads help centre (https://bigoads.com/help/detail?id=111&moduleId=11&articleId=2&currentLan=EN&isPreview=0) is still the Web Events API ('designed to provide a reliable link between Bigo and advertisers' marketing data': POST https://api.bytegle.site/bigoad/trackingevent with bbg + pixel_id), which maps to no ads verb; https://www.bigoads.com/ links developers only to the publisher SSP (https://www.bigossp.com/register). The campaign/reporting Marketing API is granted through the account manager and has no public reference, so no adapter.
